implementation.name: Green Beret (Analogue Pocket, opengateware)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 41 HDL source files (6 systemverilog, 20 verilog, 15 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this openFPGA core ships 3 MRA files of its own; 2 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 1 through MAME's own cloneof relation, giving 2 distinct machine_id rows. License: https://github.com/opengateware/arcade-gberet/blob/master/rtl/DPRAMs.v carries the tag SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later -- read from the repository, not inferred; https://github.com/opengateware/arcade-gberet/blob/master/LICENSE is the matching licence text. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 41 source files (6 systemverilog, 20 verilog, 15 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest pkg/pocket/Cores/boogermann.gberet/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier boogermann.gberet.

implementation_dependency.note: T80 Z80 core vendored at modules/cpu-t80/T80.vhd
